narrative.intro: Northrop Grumman Systems obligated $2.9B in FY2026 to date. Northrop Grumman Systems received 2 federal awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $1.4B. Obligations are up 124.5% year over year compared with the prior comparable period. Historical obligations show that Northrop Grumman Systems moved from $1.1B in FY21 to $2B in FY22, $2.9B in FY23, $3.5B in FY24, and $1.3B in FY25 before the current-year total of $2.9B. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the largest NAICS market for Northrop Grumman Systems this fiscal year at $2.9B. Engineering Services is a secondary NAICS market for Northrop Grumman Systems at $1.2M. The page notes that figures are contract obligations except where award-value figures are explicitly labeled as total contract values, and that current-year totals are partial fiscal year to date.
